body:
dw_server + random/draft bot pools redeployed with the 105-card rules (proto 3); old decks/matches logs archived as *.pre-retheme.ndjson so WOTAN shows only new-era decks; server now continues deck ids after the highest logged so restarts never reuse one (found live: ids reset to 1 and would have collided). WOTAN deployed with cards.json v2, colours, keyword filter and a season note. Verified live: draft + random probes on :6980, new cards in drafted decks, headless Chrome on wotan.okemily.com. Old binaries backed up in scratch.

⚓ ☃
title: Deployed the Offense/Operations/Defense retheme (server, 6 bots, WOTAN)
